title: Forms in Angular
description: An introduction to building forms in Angular: Reactive Forms, Template-driven Forms, and Modern Signal-based Forms.

blocks.text: Handling user input with forms is the cornerstone of many web applications. Applications use forms to enable users to log in, update a profile, enter sensitive information, and perform many other data-entry tasks.
Angular provides distinct approaches to handling forms, each suited for different use cases:

rows: Structured, explicit, and synchronous immutable stream.
Simpler for simple forms, harder to test complex flows.
Zero Zone.js overhead, seamless reactivity with computed and effect.

items: Reactive Forms: Complete guide to FormControl, FormGroup, FormBuilder, and FormArray.
Typed Forms: Strictly typed reactive forms in modern Angular.
Template-driven Forms: Two-way data binding with ngModel and ngForm.
Form Validation: Built-in validators, custom validators, cross-field validation, and async validators.
Dynamic Forms: Generating forms at runtime from metadata models.
